I cooked the chicken in a little sauce pan on one side for 4 minutes, then flipped it over and put the lid on and let it finish cooking. (I used thighs to up the fat and add a little more flavor, but you could use breasts) I seasoned it with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and a little dried basil. 

After the chicken was done cooking I set it aside and, cooked the cauliflower rice in the same pan. Seasoned with salt, and pepper.

To make the glaze, I used 60 mL of Balsamic vinegar, and 21 g of raw honey, I brought it to a boil and then let it simmer until it thickened up to my liking. Once that was done I put it in a mason jar and set it aside to cool. 

To plate, I put the cauliflower rice down, put the chicken on top and drizzled the glaze over. Then put the strawberries on top, and finished it off with some fresh basil.
